metadata.title: The 23-Hour Trading Day Is Here: What NYSE and Nasdaq’s Move Means for Investors<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
NYSE and Nasdaq Want 23-Hour Trading. Here Is What It Means for You.
The market that never sleeps is coming and it could be a boon for foreign investors, but the jury is still out on how U.S. retail investors will fare.
